item.title: Broncos secondary coach Jim Leonhard leaving for Buffalo DC job, source says
item.description: The Broncos are losing yet another coach to a coordinator posting in Buffalo. Secondary coach Jim Leonhard has been hired as the Bills' defensive coordinator.

item.title: Next week at Greeley City Council: Homeless solutions update, 1A opposition
item.description: The city council will be updated on the current status of the Homeless Solutions Department and consider a resolution urging residents to vote against ballot item 1A.
